messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gateway-prod 30m rolling increase in 5xx (504) — current 504 rate 5.2% (baseline ~0.02%). p95 latency jumped to ~2.1s. Paging oncall-jess.
oncall-jess: I'm looking. Thanks inc-bot. @maria-sre @devon-platform can you triage ingress + LB? Sam, can you surface customer impact?
sam-support: seeing a handful of live support tickets: webhook retries from Integrations team and user-facing webhook timeouts. Customers reporting "upstream timed out". Creating INC-1234 and tagging PMs. No broad billing source yet.
maria-sre: joining. quick telemetry check: gateway edge shows large tail of 504s from upstream-proxy cluster. The traces for many of these requests are missing spanids or show sampling=0. Logs for gateway-proxy pod don't consistently include x-request-id for ~40% of events — that's a big observability gap right now.
devon-platform: I see config drift on a subset of gateway nodes — an old nginx config that doesn't forward some headers. Could explain missing request-id. Also Envoy access logs were rotated earlier and sampling dropped because new sidecar image landed with sampling disabled.
oncall-jess: OK immediate mitigation plan: 1) add temporary request-id echo/logging on gateway for 30m, 2) bump trace sampling to 50% for gateway-prod, 3) route higher-retry clients to a less-constrained pool if possible. Who can do 1/2 now?
maria-sre: I'll prepare a quick Lua filter to echo an id (fall back to timestamp) into headers and access log. This is low-risk and can be hotpatched to the DS. Example snippet I'll apply to envoy filter:
```
function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
  local rid = request_handle:headers():get("x-request-id") or tostring(math.floor(os.time()*1000))
  request_handle:headers():add("x-temp-rid", rid)
end
```
I'll also add a log field: %REQ(x-temp-rid)% to access logs.
devon-platform: I'll flip trace sampling via the control-plane config API (short window). Patch command: 
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/config/sampling \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $BP' \
  -d '{"service":"gateway-prod","sampling":0.5,"ttl":1800}'
```
Doing that now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: hotpatch/gateway-temp-header-3612349999 -> gateway-prod (3/3 pods)
maria-sre: hotpatch rolled to 2/3 pods, logs now show x-temp-rid for new requests. Still seeing some 504s but now we can tie requests to traces.
sam-support: handing the list of affected customers to PMs and CSMs: linked ticket INC-1234, severity elevated to P2 because multiple paying customers affected. Notifying slack #customers.
ryan-eng: I'll stand up a temporary routing rule to drain traffic away from the old nginx-config nodes. Quick patch: set nodeSelector on ingress DaemonSet for canary=false to route. Doing that now.
devon-platform: trace sampling API returned 200; sampling=50% enabled for gateway-prod. Expect more traces to appear within ~30s.
maria-sre: confirmed traces populating with x-temp-rid mapping. We can correlate support errors to spans now. Root cause look: a subset of backend connections hit a threadpool exhaustion on upstream-proxy during high concurrent requests leading to connection timeout -> 504. The observability gap hid correlation earlier.
oncall-jess: Excellent. For mitigation timeline: Maria/Devon enacted instrumentation and routing at T+7m after alert. P50/P95 trending down but still above baseline. Can we put automated fallback to a lower-latency model? (i.e., route to warm pool)
devon-platform: added temporary route to warm-pool in traffic router. This reduces load on the stressed upstream cluster.
pm-lee: Notifying enterprise customers, noting mitigating steps. We'll open a status page update if errors persist past 15m.
sam-support: CS updated customers A/B with diagnostic id list (x-temp-rid values) so they can correlate retries.
maria-sre: monitoring shows 504 rate dropped from 5.2% -> 0.8% after routing + sampling + hotpatch. Good. I'll keep the temporary headers and sampling for 30m and then roll back once stable.
oncall-jess: I'm due for a handoff in 18m. @ryan-eng, can you take next watch? I'll post a short context summary before I go.
ryan-eng: I can take it. Please annotate the handoff with what to monitor (504 rate, p95 latency, x-temp-rid incidence) and any CLI commands to revert the changes.
oncall-jess: Handoff summary: INCIDENT INC-1234 — gateway-prod 504 spike; actions taken: hotpatch Lua to add x-temp-rid (rolled to all pods), increased trace sampling to 50% for 30m, drained legacy nginx nodes, routed traffic to warm-pool. Current status: error rate dropping to 0.8%, traces/req ids present. Followups: postmortem to capture why sidecar sampling was disabled and why nginx config drifted.
maria-sre: I'll start a postmortem doc and link known artifacts. Temporary instrumentation will be removed after monitoring window unless we spot regressions.
ryan-eng: Thanks. I'll watch overnight and escalate if >1% 504 persists. If you need me to flip anything back, ping me with the x-temp-rid list or the INC ticket.
pm-lee: Adding a note to roadmap to require header-forwarding tests in CI for gateway images.
inc-bot: :white_check_mark: UPDATE: 30m check — gateway-prod 504 now 0.3%. Sampling window will be auto-removed at +30m unless extended by oncall.
maria-sre: removing temp headers and reverting logging change now. Rolling removal to avoid long-term noise.
deploy-bot: deploy started: revert/gateway-temp-header-3612349999 -> gateway-prod (3/3 pods)
maria-sre: revert complete. Access logs no longer include x-temp-rid. Trace sampling restored to baseline.
sam-support: CS update sent to all impacted customers. Marking INC-1234 as mitigated; collecting follow-up items for postmortem.
oncall-jess: Thanks everyone. I'll file a short post-incident checklist: - ensure sampling config is validated on deploy - include header-forwarding unit test - tighten alerts to detect missing request-id entropy.
pm-lee: postmortem link: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-1234-postmortem (will add details).
maria-sre: adding root-cause analysis and recommended action items to the postmortem.
ryan-eng: taking next watch. ping me in #oncall if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
